title: Glossary
description: Technical terms used in our documentation

terms.definition: Space Station 14. Remake of Space Station 13 (SS13).
Space Station 13. The original game that Space Station 14 (SS14) is based on.
The game engine for SS13.
Custom game engine on which SS14 is built.
The 'game' running on RobustToolbox.
Convar/Console Variable. Configurable value that you can change in the config files or through the console.
YAML Ain't Markup Language. Used to define prototypes.
Tom's Obvious Minimal Language. Like YAML but for config.
Entity Component System
Inversion of Control
BYOND/SS13's sprite file format. Converted to an RSI for our usage.
Robust Station Images. SS14's image 'file' format (actually a folder).
Potentially Visible Set. Stops the server from sending out-of-range entities to clients.
Visual Studio Code. Not the same as VS.
Visual Studio Community 2017/19. Not the same as VSC. The IDE for people who can't get a Rider license.
A crossplatform IDE for C#. (Can be obtained for free for non-commercial use).
SS14 Server Watchdog. Used for dedicated server logging, updating and general management.
Networking library.
The basis for SS14's (heavily modified) physics system.
UI framework used for the launcher.
Entity Unique Identifier
